title: SetupPathsRequest
description: PUT /setup/paths: use files the user already has instead of downloading. Send both keys; null means the default location under the data dir, and a value equal to the current one is kept without a new check. Starts a job that checks changed paths (model: size + sha256 against the profile; llama: `--version` reports the pinned build) before they are used.

model_path.description: Full path of the base GGUF file.

llama_dir.description: Folder that holds llama-server.exe and its DLLs.
